analyst_view.overall: Excelsior lost 0-9 at home to Twente last weekend after Nesto Groen was sent off early, and coach Den Uil called it a mental collapse. They have one point from their last six games. Go Ahead Eagles lost 4-0 at Cambuur in a game abandoned late for fireworks, with the result standing. Their games this season have been open, and Tengstedt has eight goals.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals, already high. Excelsior's defence has collapsed recently, but their attack has failed to score in three of four, so the two pull against each other and we stay with the numbers.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners. Nothing in the news moves it.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.8 cards. We found nothing on referee Jeroen Manschot, and the crowd tension after the Cambuur incident has been handled with travel restrictions for away fans, so we stay level.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.2 shots. No news points either way.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 shots on target. Go Ahead create a lot through Tengstedt and Edvardsen, and Excelsior's defence has been easy to get through, so we lean slightly higher.
